stories.text: As the Norn runtime, I want to verify a counterparty's certificate chain at the MCP boundary — at the dispatch instant, via `verify_certificate_chain_at` — so that cross-agent tool calls are gated on legitimate, unexpired, capability-scoped identity.
As an auditor, I want `lys ca verify` with an explicit instant so that I can check whether a certificate was valid at the time a disputed action occurred, not just at the time of my audit.
